review_description: I had four quotes in total.It was obvious Soventix knew exactly what they were on about. I would recommend them to anybody.

Souventic  was the cheapest of five quotes that I obtained.  The panels and inverter are all top quality German manufactured and a work colleague of mine has very recently had a system installed by Souventix.It really wasn't a difficult decision to make.  The installation starts TOMORROW.
